title: 2025 statewide rule with revealed binding (D1): within-state effective-floor dose, FY2025 vs FY2026 Q1-Q3
proposer: catalogue (plan A1); effective-floor dose from triage_credibility N2 / triage_power P2; within-state D1 layer from triage_power (merged by triage merge)
implementer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Phase 3 A1 designer; Phase 4-5 estimator)
estimand: PPML semi-elasticity of county certified H-2A contract hours (rq13d) per dollar of the predicted change in the binding H-2A cash floor, b_c x (F_c - e25_s), identified within state (county FE + state x FY FE); converted to epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat_U) x C_bar.
primary_outcome: cert_hours_rq13d, PPML on county counts, county FE + state x FY FE, FY2025 vs FY2026 (receipt window: received and decided 1 Oct - 30 Jun)
dose: x = e25_s in FY2025 and e25_s + b_c x (F_c - e25_s) in FY2026, dollars per hour; e25 = FY2025 AEWR (minimum wage never binding in FY2025); F = max(H-2A skill-I statewide cash rate of 2025-10-02, applicable state agricultural minimum wage in force 2026-01-01, NY and OR sub-state areas); b_c = FY2025 county at-AEWR share of known-AEWR hourly hours (rq13d), state share if unknown. Minimum wage binds over the H-2A skill-I rate in 16 of 48 states.
identifying_assumption: Within a state, counties with higher FY2025 at-AEWR binding shares would have had the same FY2025-to-FY2026 proportional growth in certified hours as lower-share counties absent the 2025 rule.

conversion.formula: epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat_U) x C_bar; C_bar = ratio_A1 x w_bar = 1.2401 x 15.2607 = 18.924; ITT bound eta x C_bar (pi = 1); epsilon_w = epsilon_cost / ratio_A1

cost_ratio_used.rule: hours-weighted FY2025 cost_ratio and FY2026 central_vs_h2a_cash (dose on H-2A cash floor)

conversion.first_stage_spec: Phase 5: WLS of county hours-weighted mean offered hourly wage (U.S.-worker rate; FY2026 receipts >= 2025-10-02) on the U.S.-rate binding dose, county FE + state x FY FE, PPML calibration weights
conversion.assumptions: dC = d(H-2A cash floor) (non-wage cost fixed); pass-through to the unobserved H-2A cash wage equals pass-through to the disclosed U.S.-worker offer (A-pi); employers price the floor in force at filing (2025-10-02 schedule, 2026-01-01 minimum wage); county totals include entry and exit
conversion.first_stage_detail: pi_hat_U = 0.03269 (state CRV1 se 0.1012, jackknife se 0.1040), F = 0.104 < 10: declared weak-first-stage rule triggered. Secondary first stage on x^H: 0.02665 (se 0.07605). 2,832 counties, 48 states.

support.basis: two-period FY2025-FY2026 frame, PPML weights = FY2020-FY2025 county mean rq13d hours; residual SD of the PPML-linearized FY2020-FY2025 outcome after county + state x FY FE
support.other_candidates: cross-state statutory H-2A (region x FY) SD 0.385, 4.97 effective states, max leverage 0.40 (AR); cross-state effective floor SD 0.474, 9.49, 0.27 (AR); cross-state D1 SD 0.492, 16.5, 0.18 (AR); employer x state within-state SD 0.525, 13.8, 0.18 (49,050 units, residual SD 0.73); truncation SD 0.20, 13.9, 0.16 (OR); file $S/A1/a1_support.csv

design_mde_by_dgp.note: epsilon_cost units at pi = 1 (declared design pi for a binding-floor dose); county_serial value uses former-region CRV1 because state CRV1 (null 0.065, upper 0.082) and the state jackknife (0.060, 0.0765) narrowly fail the size gate under that DGP; at pi = 0.8: 1.03; at pi = 0.65 (Track 1 statutory first stage): 1.26

gate_dgp: max over shared DGPs: ish_node_period_share() on the PPML-linearized FY2020-FY2025 rq13d hours with county + state x FY FE gives 0.0164 vs 0.0100 pure unit noise (ratio 1.64 > 1.5). Stress node state x FY2025 binding half: 0.0361 vs 0.0301 (ratio 1.20, no stress gate); under the stress shared DGPs no method passes the size gate (state CRV1 null 0.069, jackknife 0.059 with upper 0.0754).
inference_primary: state_fips_CRV1 on the PPML fit (passes the size gate under every shared DGP; registry rule)
split_detail: No data-driven tuning; every choice fixed in the registry (48 states would permit a split).
prior_exposure: Track 1 FY2026 Q1-Q3 (dq13) certified positions, hours and equal-county ratios by county, PPML positions/hours and offered-wage first stages (0.66 U.S. skill I, 0.65 H-2A skill I, 0.82 U.S. skill II) on cross-state statutory doses, FY2024-25 placebo and FY2012-24 event study (markdowns/alternative_identification_exploration.md section 3); Track 2 pre-2025 minimum-wage null (section 4); Phase 0 national FY2026 totals by window (outcome_national_by_window.csv, also printed by this designer); credibility triage FY2026 certified positions and offered wages by FY2025 experience class; power triage FY2020-25 residual variance. Within-state binding-share contrasts in FY2026 and county rq13d FY2026 hours and requested positions have not been examined.
falsification_result: pass. Gating: F1 FY2024-25 placebo eta = -0.01006 (state CRV1 se 0.009036, p = 0.271); F2 FY2020-25 linear drift = 0.005882 (se 0.006514, p = 0.371). Reported: F3 event study joint jackknife Wald p = 0.861 (CRV1 p = 0.846); F4a truncation b x trunc = -0.02176 (p = 0.577); F4b pre-period role switch = -0.007997 (p = 0.638); F5a (1 - b) term = 0.003339 (p = 0.808); F5b MW-floored interaction = -0.009048 (p = 0.869), statutory dose fits worse (loglik -4613497.3 vs -4613109.3); F5c piece-rate interaction = -0.005909 (p = 0.306); F6 balance: within-state weighted corr of D_c with FY2025 field-SOC share = -0.593 (p < 0.001), other covariates |corr| <= 0.061.
post_outcome_analyses: 07_post_outcome_first_stage_descriptive.R -> a1_post_outcome_first_stage_descriptive.csv: PPML-weighted mean FY2025-to-FY2026 change in county offered wage by within-state binding half (written after the first-stage F was seen; descriptive only)
notes: Decision: PROCEED (gate MDE 0.82 <= 1.0) with FLAGS: (1) MDE > 0.5 (not 'informative' alone); (2) conversion-sensitive: MDE / 0.65 = 1.26 > 1.0, so if pi_hat is near Track 1's statutory 0.65 the realized cost-unit MDE will exceed 1.0; (3) state-cluster size is marginal under county-serial noise (null 0.065) and no method passes under the within-state binding-half stress DGP (null 0.059-0.069); (4) the declared DGPs contain no crop shocks correlated with binding share. Lead secondary requested positions (rq13d): gate MDE 1.08-1.10. Cross-state layers fail: D1 cross-state 2.93, effective floor 3.78 (shared DGP gate). Pooling eligibility is design-stage only, conditional on Phase 4 falsification and Phase 6 review. New sourced table: explorations/identification_search/A1/sources/state_ag_minwage_fy2025_2026.csv (FY2025-26 state agricultural minimum wages for H-2A, fixes FL 2025-09-30 step and NY upstate/downstate, adds OR tiers). Outputs in $S/A1. | ESTIMATION (Phase 4-5, 2026-11-05): registry hash verified; gating falsification passed. Primary eta = -0.004508 per dollar (state CRV1 se 0.01185, 95% CI [-0.02835, 0.01933], p = 0.705; jackknife se 0.01247; region CRV1 p = 0.753); 2,923 counties, 48 states. First stage pi_U = 0.03269 (se 0.1012), F = 0.104: WEAK; per the registry epsilon_cost is reported only with the Fieller/AR set, which is the whole real line (point (eta/pi) x C_bar = -2.61 is not a headline; jackknife SE 61.8; realized MDE 2.8 x jackknife SE = 173.). ITT bound (pi = 1): eta x C_bar = -0.0853, 95% CI [-0.536, 0.366] (realized ITT MDE 0.628 vs design 0.82). Lead secondary requested positions eta = -0.004755 (se 0.01720, p = 0.783; ITT eps -0.0900 [-0.745, 0.565]). Pooling: eligibility is left as set by the design-stage and falsification rules; the synthesis lead should note that the declared conversion yields an unbounded epsilon_cost set (inclusion criterion 'converts to the primary estimand'), and that the jackknife SE of epsilon_cost gives negligible inverse-variance weight. Implementation choices within the registry text: CRV1 p-values use t(G-1) (harness convention); FY2025 SOC and piece rate from h2a_disclosure_records by case_number (case-row soc7 is blank for 59% of FY2025 hours); counties without FY2025 rows take the state FY2025-hours-weighted share for S7/S9 covariates and F5c; F5c median weighted by FY2025 rq13d hours; SD2 RI by state within region not run because F_c varies within NY and OR (as at the design stage).
